purpose: Frozen reference for the promotion gate. Strict policy invariants decide exact behavior; corpus-dependent metrics only reject a collapse toward a measured degraded control.
why_this_exists: The corpus drifts (memories added, content edited, links rebuilt). A baseline measured in the same run as the candidate therefore moves on its own: on 2026-09-12 the baseline gained exactly one rank step (MRR 0.740196 -> 0.769608) while the corrected routing was byte-identical at MRR 0.754902. That flipped the verdict from keep to revert with no code change. A verdict that reports the corpus instead of the code is not a gate.

source_run.note: the last audited run whose verdict was keep, before the corpus drift

no_answer_false_result_rate.rationale: The corrected routing exists to stop returning results for questions the corpus cannot answer. This target does not depend on the corpus: it is a property of the routing policy. It is the criterion that must not be traded away.

mrr.rationale: MRR is corpus-dependent, so it cannot be a fine promotion criterion. On lancedb==0.34.0, removing one edge (memory_edges rows 138 -> 137) moved both corrected_hybrid (0.754902 -> 0.725490) and the frozen lexical degraded control (0.593137 -> 0.563725) by exactly one maximum rank step (0.5/17 = 0.029412), while code was unchanged. The anti-collapse target is therefore the frozen degraded control plus that one measured noise step: 0.593137 + 0.029412 = 0.622549. Cost: the gate can accept up to 0.132353 MRR below the healthy reference; in return it rejects collapse toward lexical behavior without flapping on the observed corpus reorder.

recall_at_5.rationale: Recall is also corpus-dependent and is therefore only an anti-collapse guardrail. Across the same lancedb==0.34.0 runs at 138 and 137 memory_edges rows, lexical recall stayed 0.764706 and corrected_hybrid recall stayed 0.852941: observed recall noise was 0. The candidate must remain strictly above the frozen lexical degraded control. Cost: one whole-answer loss from 0.852941 remains above the guardrail, while two such losses fall below it.

why_engine_is_recorded: The BM25 scores these targets were measured on are engine-specific: the same rows and query scored 12.774 under lancedb 0.34.0 but 14.398 under 0.38.0. A target without its engine is not reproducible.
